description: Batch job nightly_claims_load failed with connection timeout error while writing to claims_processing database
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion during peak nightly batch window
resolution: Increased connection pool size from 10 to 25 and staggered batch job start times

description: Underwriting exception queue stuck, batch job underwriting_risk_scoring timed out connecting to database
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion, same root cause as INC-001
resolution: Applied same connection pool fix as INC-001

description: Policy renewal batch job failed overnight, database connections exhausted during month end processing
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion during month-end peak load
resolution: Temporary workaround: restarted batch job with reduced parallelism

description: Claim status update failed to sync to customer portal after adjuster approval
root_cause: Message queue consumer service crashed silently, messages backed up unprocessed
resolution: Restarted consumer service and added health check monitoring

description: Customer notification emails for policy renewal not sent, queue backing up
root_cause: Message queue consumer service crashed, same failure mode as INC-004
resolution: Applied same consumer restart fix, escalated for permanent monitoring fix

description: Underwriting risk scoring batch produced incorrect scores for a subset of commercial policies
root_cause: Third-party credit risk API returned malformed response, not caught by validation layer
resolution: Added response schema validation before scores are committed

description: New claim submissions rejected with generic validation error, no clear cause in logs
root_cause: Unknown - insufficient logging detail, root cause never fully confirmed
resolution: Temporary manual override applied by support team, root cause investigation deprioritized

description: Policy document generation batch failed for a small number of auto insurance policies
root_cause: PDF template engine ran out of memory processing an unusually large policy document
resolution: Increased memory allocation for the PDF generation service
